title: albizia attopeuensis
intro: Albizia attopeuensis, commonly known as the Attopeu Albizia or White Siris, is a species of tree in the family Fabaceae. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disorders. The health benefits of Albizia attopeuensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects.
